faqs.question: How long does a website take to design and build?
faqs.answer: Timing depends on project scope, pages, and requirements. A focused landing page can typically take 1–2 weeks, while a full custom website with SEO architecture and backend systems usually takes 3–4 weeks.

faqs.question: Do you provide SEO and digital marketing services?
faqs.answer: Yes. As Hasnain Digital Marketer, I offer comprehensive SEO (technical audits, on-page optimization, keyword research, link building) and digital marketing campaigns to ensure your site is discoverable and drives measurable business growth.

faqs.question: Can you redesign an existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can audit your current website, identify technical SEO and UX bottlenecks, modernize the interface, and rebuild key pages for fast mobile speed and Core Web Vitals compliance.

faqs.question: What information do you need before starting a project?
faqs.answer: A summary of your business goals, target audience, primary services or products, current website URL (if you have one), and your preferred launch timeline is sufficient to begin the discovery process.

faqs.question: Do you provide Python development and automation?
faqs.answer: Yes. I develop custom Python applications, automation scripts, backend services, REST APIs, and data processing tools tailored to your operational needs.
